result.detail: Cliq REST API uses OAuth. Any developer self-registers a client in Zoho API console (Add Client ID, Create); no review step in docs. Cliq extensions: once published, anyone with install link can install for their org. Review only needed for optional Zoho Marketplace listing via Partner Console. No install/user cap for unreviewed apps found. Caveat: marketing-guidelines terms page not checked; OAuth client-registration page 404'd, so no-review for OAuth is from silence.
result.quote: Once published, users with the extension installation link can install your extension for the organization.
